# Command line

## Commands

### `detect` { #detect }

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-t, --threads` | 1 | How many threads. |
| `--pattern` | loops | The pattern to look for. |
| `--no-plotting` | | No plots. |

### `quantify` { #quantify }

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-t, --threads` | 1 | How many threads. |
| `--win-size` | auto | The window's size. |

### `list` { #list }

Every option of the list, since its usage says `[options]`:

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-t, --threads` | 1 | How many threads. |
| `--pattern` | loops | The pattern to look for. |
| `--no-plotting` | | No plots. |
| `--win-size` | auto | The window's size. |
| `--long` | | Every detail. |
